title: feat(formula): publish the home-amount conversion arithmetic

_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi91WUDPBNqRzVkEppXR4HpYx)_
Fixes #31609

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:把引擎换算本位币金额的四个纯函数(`toScaledDecimal`、`divideToPlaces`、`formatScaledDecimal`、`documentDateOf`)和 `ScaledDecimal` 类型原样从 `objectql` 内部文件搬到已发布包 `@objectstack/formula` 并导出;`objectql` 改为导入回来,行为不变。
- 为什么改:#27196 要在发票表单上实时预览「≈ 本位币金额」,数字必须与保存时引擎算出的一致;前端已依赖 `formula`、不依赖 `objectql`,不允许复制第二份。
- 风险与回滚:纯搬移,两段函数体逐字节相同(下方 Verification 有比对);三个既有换算测试文件一行未改且全绿。因 ADR-0144 有两处路径锚点指向被搬的文件,本 PR 同时改了这两处括注(受管面,Tier H)。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`packages/formula/src/home-amount-arithmetic.ts`(搬来的函数),`packages/objectql/src/home-amount-projection.ts` 顶部的导入/再导出,ADR-0144 第 387、402 行附近的锚点改动。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/formula exec vitest run src/home-amount-arithmetic.test.ts`,预期 5 个用例全绿(JPY 0 位、USD 2 位、KWD 3 位、平分远离零、时区取日)。
- 需要你做的:批准本 PR(改动触及 `docs/adr/**`,需 GOVERNED_APPROVERS 批准后由席位落地)。

## What changes

- **New module `packages/formula/src/home-amount-arithmetic.ts`.** `toScaledDecimal`, `divideToPlaces` (with its private `divideRoundHalfAwayFromZero` and `abs`), `formatScaledDecimal`, `documentDateOf` (with its private `calendarDayIn`, `CALENDAR_DATE`) and the `ScaledDecimal` type, moved byte-identical out of `packages/objectql/src/home-amount-projection.ts`, under a new module header. The module imports nothing.
- **`packages/formula/src/index.ts`** exports the four functions and the `ScaledDecimal` type under their engine names. No clash in formula's index (`git grep` for each name on `origin/main` hits only objectql and ADR-0144).
- **`packages/objectql/src/home-amount-projection.ts`** imports them from `@objectstack/formula` and re-exports them, so `home-amount-recompute.ts` and the projection test keep their import site. `toStoredNumber` (a projection-only step) stays. `CURRENCY_FRACTION_DIGITS` stays in `@objectstack/spec`. No new dependency edge: objectql, `ui/packages/core` and `ui/packages/app-shell` already depend on `@objectstack/formula`, which depends only on `@objectstack/spec`.
- **Forced edit, governed: `docs/adr/0144-…-write-time-home-projection.md`** (+4/−2, seat claim amendment on #31609). Two anchor parentheticals pointed at `packages/objectql/src/home-amount-projection.ts#documentDateOf` and `#divideToPlaces`, `#divideRoundHalfAwayFromZero`, `#toScaledDecimal`. `divideRoundHalfAwayFromZero` is private and moves, so `pnpm check:adr-symbol-anchors` (required, `Lint & Repo Gates`) reds on any move-only diff. Both now point at `packages/formula/src/home-amount-arithmetic.ts`, and the 402 parenthetical says the arithmetic moved there unchanged on 2026-11-08 in #31609. No decision text changed.
- Changeset `.changeset/31609-home-amount-arithmetic-formula.md`: `@objectstack/formula` patch, `@objectstack/objectql` patch (see Acceptance notes on the level).

## Tests

- **New:** `packages/formula/src/home-amount-arithmetic.test.ts` (5 cases), imported through formula's index: exact-decimal reading (number, string, bigint; non-numbers spell none); the CLDR digits read from `CURRENCY_FRACTION_DIGITS` — JPY `100 ÷ 0.0065 → 15385`, USD `100 ÷ 1.0857 → 92.11`, KWD `100 ÷ 3.2468 → 30.800`, CNY `10000 ÷ 0.1389 → 71994.24` (the #27196 sample); the half-away-from-zero tie on both signs (`0.125 → 0.13`, `-0.125 → -0.13`, JPY `0.5 → 1`, KWD `-0.0005 → -0.001`, `1.005 → 1.01`); a `datetime` taken as its calendar day in Asia/Shanghai and America/New_York; UTC when the zone is unset, `UTC` or unknown.
- **Unchanged and green:** `home-amount-projection.test.ts`, `engine-home-amount-projection.test.ts`, `home-amount-write-paths.test.ts` (0 lines changed). No other test file is edited.
- No ablation: the diff changes no tested behaviour (move-only); the new pin's red leg is main itself (below).

## Acceptance notes

- **Changeset level.** The delta asked for `minor` on formula. `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` (the level axis, maintainer ruling A) requires a declared `Metadata-protocol: none` to grade every entry it introduces `patch`, so both entries are `patch`. Raised with the seat in the report.
- **New export names** (`toScaledDecimal`, `divideToPlaces`, `formatScaledDecimal`, `documentDateOf`, `ScaledDecimal`) keep the engine's names; listed for the seat's ruling at ACCEPT.
